# Nama — Industrial Portfolio CMS

## Summary

Nama is a Next.js 16 and Payload CMS 3 industrial portfolio/content-management website. It uses TypeScript, React 19, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Docker Compose, and pnpm.

## Main capabilities

- Public industrial portfolio website
- Payload CMS admin panel at `/admin`
- Pages, posts, projects, media, categories, and users
- Reusable layout-builder blocks
- SEO metadata, sitemap generation, search, redirects, drafts, and live preview
- Unit/integration tests with Vitest and end-to-end tests with Playwright

## Repository map

- `src/app/`: Next.js application routes and UI
- `src/collections/`: Payload collection definitions
- `src/globals/`: global CMS configuration
- `src/blocks/`: reusable content blocks
- `public/`: static files
- `tests/`: automated tests
- `scripts/`: translation and project utility scripts
- `payload.config.ts`: Payload CMS configuration
- `next.config.ts`: Next.js configuration
- `package.json`: scripts and dependencies

## Local development

1. Install Node.js 20+ and pnpm 9+.
2. Copy `.env.example` to `.env`.
3. Set secure local values for `PAYLOAD_SECRET` and PostgreSQL.
4. Run `docker compose up -d postgres`.
5. Run `pnpm install`.
6. Run `pnpm dev` and open `http://localhost:3000`.

## Important safety note

Do not commit `.env`, database files, build output, or uploaded media. These are excluded by `.gitignore`. Use Payload push mode only for local development; use version-controlled migrations for staging and production.
